## 1. Executive Entity Summary

Gayatri Technology is an engineering-first custom software and industrial ERP studio founded and led by Parth Raval in Rajkot, Gujarat, India. 

The studio builds custom operational software, shop-floor manufacturing ERP systems, field mobile applications, and B2B portals for manufacturing units, industrial stockyards, distributors, and community institutions.

### Core Value Proposition
Unlike generic SaaS ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Zoho, Busy) that charge recurring monthly per-user licensing fees and force businesses into rigid workflows, Gayatri Technology builds bespoke systems around the client's existing workflow with:
1. **100% Client Source Code Ownership:** Full IP and codebase handed over to the client upon final milestone payment.
2. **Zero Per-Seat License Fees:** Deployable on client-owned cloud or on-premise hardware (e.g., AWS, Hetzner, DigitalOcean, local server) with zero per-user software taxes.
3. **Engineered for the Floor:** Mobile-first, touch-friendly interfaces designed for workers wearing gloves in dusty stockyards or noisy factory bays.
4. **Direct Founder & Engineer Access:** Clients communicate directly with the software architect writing their code, eliminating layers of non-technical sales middlemen.

## 3. Core Engineering Services & Disciplines

### 3.1 Custom Business Software
- **Focus:** Internal operational tools that consolidate scattered spreadsheets and coordinate multi-department operations.
- **Problem Solved:** Staff spending hours manually copying orders and customer data across five disconnected Excel workbooks.
- **Key Deliverables:** Role-based access control (Admin, Manager, Operator), order and quotation tracking, automated PDF reporting, WhatsApp notifications.
- **Typical Delivery:** 4–6 weeks.
- **Platform:** Responsive Web Application & Cloud Dashboard.

### 3.2 ERP & Operations Systems
- **Focus:** Manufacturing, stockyard, and multi-branch industrial groups.
- **Problem Solved:** Stock counts out of sync between yard and office; delivery challans taking 20 minutes of manual math.
- **Key Deliverables:** Multi-facility piece and batch inventory tracking, shape-aware theoretical weight math engine (<15ms latency), digital delivery challans with customer GSTIN, lorry numbers, and instant PDF printing.
- **Typical Delivery:** 6–8 weeks.
- **Platform:** Android Mobile App + Responsive Web ERP.

### 3.3 Websites & Web Applications
- **Focus:** Technical manufacturing businesses needing authoritative web portals that convert commercial buyers.
- **Problem Solved:** Outdated, slow template websites that fail to demonstrate technical credibility or rank on search engines.
- **Key Deliverables:** High-performance Next.js architectures, sub-second load times, interactive specification catalogs, 1-click WhatsApp quote requests, structured JSON-LD schemas.
- **Typical Delivery:** 2–4 weeks.
- **Platform:** Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Vercel/Node.js.

### 3.4 Mobile Applications
- **Focus:** Field staff, warehouse dispatchers, lorry supervisors, and executives on the go.
- **Problem Solved:** Inability to update stock or issue dispatch challans from the stockyard floor.
- **Key Deliverables:** Fast Android applications, high-contrast typography, offline capability, camera barcode/QR scanning, one-tap PDF sharing.
- **Typical Delivery:** 4–6 weeks.
- **Platform:** Android & Cross-Platform Mobile.

### 3.5 E-Commerce & B2B Portals
- **Focus:** Wholesale distributors, component suppliers, and material traders.
- **Problem Solved:** Sales staff fielding hundreds of repetitive pricing and stock inquiry calls every day.
- **Key Deliverables:** Customer-specific tier pricing, live inventory allocation preventing overselling, credit term tracking, automated tax invoicing.
- **Typical Delivery:** 4–6 weeks.
- **Platform:** Responsive Web & Dealer Portal.

### 3.6 Automation & Workflow Tools
- **Focus:** Repetitive manual data-entry elimination.
- **Problem Solved:** Team members manually emailing challans, copying tracking numbers, and messaging customers on WhatsApp.
- **Key Deliverables:** Official WhatsApp Cloud API integration, automated PDF delivery upon dispatch completion, spreadsheet-to-database synchronization bridges.
- **Typical Delivery:** 2–3 weeks.
- **Platform:** Background Engines & WhatsApp Cloud API.

## 4. Production Systems & Architecture Case Studies

### 4.1 Gayatri Steel Mobile Operations Suite
- **Application Category:** Android & Web Industrial ERP Suite
- **Client:** Gayatri Steel Group (Rajkot, Gujarat)
- **Delivered Capabilities:**
  - Instant Metallurgy Weight Calculator: Computes theoretical steel weight from shape (Round bar, Flat, Square, Pipe, Hexagonal) and alloy density (e.g. 7.85 g/cm³ for tool steel) in <15ms.
  - Digital Delivery Challans: Dispatch supervisors issue complete GST-compliant delivery challans on Android phones in 20–30 seconds while trucks idle at the gate.
  - Multi-Branch Stock Tracking: Real-time inventory synchronization across Rajkot facilities.
  - Chemical Composition Lookup: Fast reference for 28+ tool steel grades with DIN, AISI, and JIS cross-standards.
- **User Impact:** Truck wait times reduced from 25 minutes to under 2 minutes per dispatch; eliminated dispatch calculation errors.

### 4.2 Gayatri Steel Group Web Portal
- **Application Category:** Industrial B2B Platform & Technical Catalog
- **Client:** Gayatri Steel Group
- **Delivered Capabilities:**
  - Interactive Alloy Catalog: Complete technical specifications for 28+ cold-work, hot-work, and plastic-mold tool steels (e.g., DIN 1.2083 ESR, DIN 1.2379 / D2, H13).
  - 1-Click WhatsApp RFQ: Buyers browse metallurgical chemical specs on smartphones and send pre-filled quotation requests directly to the commercial desk.

### 4.3 Gujarat Brahm Samaj Executive ERP Suite (v2.4.0)
- **Application Category:** Governance, Census & Member Management ERP
- **Client:** Shree Samast Gujarat Brahm Samaj (Sabarkantha / Idar Chapter)
- **Delivered Capabilities:**
  - Native Gujarati Unicode Engine: Complete Gujarati script support across registration forms, fee ledgers, and ID templates.
  - Offline SQLite Autonomy: Runs locally on office desktop computers without requiring continuous internet or monthly cloud hosting bills.
  - Instant Photo ID Card Generation: 1-click generation and printing of standardized official member ID cards with automated QR validation.
  - Financial Ledger & Fee Tracking: Official receipts for ₹500 lifetime memberships with audited numerical sequence controls.

### 4.4 Interactive Next.js Production Prototypes
- **Overview:** Fully functional web application prototypes engineered on Next.js App Router, demonstrating real conversion workflows, mathematical engines, and zero proprietary builder lock-in.
- **Key Prototypes:**
  1. *SHIBUI Modern Edomae Dining (`/demos/restaurant`):* Counter omakase seating reservation engine with micro-seasonal tasting menus, slide-over dining cart, and 140ms WhatsApp booking webhook alerts.
  2. *BrandSurge B2B Corporate Merchandise (`/demos/b2b`):* Wholesale portal featuring dynamic volume MOQ discount curves, live Pantone & laser-engraving branding previews, and 1-tap WhatsApp quotation triggers.
  3. *MAISON ÉLAN Hair & Color Studio (`/demos/salon`):* Luxury salon appointment scheduling system with master stylist schedule locking, treatment add-on customization, and automated mobile confirmations.
  4. *Bloomfield Early Learning Academy (`/demos/preschool`):* Reggio Emilia preschool admissions portal with scheduled parent campus tour reservations, age-tier curriculum breakdown, and instant WhatsApp inquiry routing.
- **Architecture Highlights:** Compiled React Server Components with sub-400ms loading, zero third-party plugin bloat, 100% source code ownership, and direct API integrations.

## 6. Practical Engineering Knowledge Base

### 6.1 When to Move from Excel to ERP
- **Core Principle:** Do not replace spreadsheets until your team hits measurable operational friction. If you process under 100 transactions monthly with 1–2 people, stay on Excel.
- **The 5 Bottleneck Indicators:**
  1. *Duplicate Data Entry:* Sales types into Excel, warehouse copies into stock sheet, accounts retypes into Tally.
  2. *Conflicting Versions:* Arguments over "Stock_Final_v3.xlsx" vs "Stock_Updated.xlsx".
  3. *Broken Formulas:* Overwritten cells causing under-billing or dispatch errors.
  4. *Delayed Customer Answers:* 20 minutes spent calling around to find order or lorry status.
  5. *Month-End Reporting Paralysis:* 3 days of manual copy-pasting to calculate margins or stock losses.
- **Transition Strategy:** Phased rollout. Replace only the highest-friction workflow (e.g. delivery challan generation or inventory stock counts) first.

### 6.2 Custom ERP vs. Ready-Made SaaS
- **The Per-User Trap:** Ready-made software charging ₹2,000/user/month costs ₹6,00,000 annually for 25 staff members. Over 3 years, SaaS costs ₹18,00,000 with zero equity or code ownership.
- **Staff Resistance:** 60% of generic ERP implementations fail because warehouse supervisors cannot navigate complex multi-tab forms on the factory floor.
- **Decision Rule:** Buy off-the-shelf if your workflow is generic (standard retail shop). Build custom if your operational workflow is your competitive advantage (manufacturing, metallurgy, specialized dispatch).

### 6.3 Shop-Floor Manufacturing ERP Essentials
- **Floor-First Reality:** Desktop-only systems fail on the shop floor. Systems must be mobile-first and offline-tolerant.
- **Essential Modules:**
  1. *Shape-Aware Weight Math:* Calculates theoretical weight from diameter, thickness, length, and density (<15ms).
  2. *Grade & Chemistry Database:* Instant verification of alloy percentages against Mill Test Certificates.
  3. *Multi-GST Entity Switching:* Seamlessly switch between trading, manufacturing, and job-work sister entities without logging out.
  4. *Paperless 30-Second Challans:* Direct dispatch PDF generation with lorry details and vehicle numbers.
  5. *Off-Cut / Scrap Tracking:* Retaining high-value off-cut dimensions in active inventory.

### 6.4 The "WhatsApp + Excel + Tally" Triad
- **The Reality:** 90% of Indian SMBs use WhatsApp for client chats, Excel for stock tracking, and Tally for statutory accounting.
- **The Solution:** Do not attempt to replace Tally. Keep Tally for tax and final accounts. Build a custom operations layer in front of Tally that captures customer orders, updates live inventory, coordinates dispatch, and connects with the official WhatsApp Cloud API to deliver automatic delivery challans.

### 6.5 Custom Software Development Cost in India
- **Cost Drivers:** Complex workflow calculations, multi-tier user permissions, third-party hardware/API integrations (WhatsApp Cloud API, GSTIN, barcode printers), and data migration.
- **Realistic Budget Benchmarks:**
  - *High-Performance Lead & Specification Portal:* ₹25,000 – ₹60,000.
  - *Custom Operational Web Application:* ₹75,000 – ₹1,75,000.
  - *Full Custom Mobile + Web ERP Suite:* ₹2,00,000 – ₹5,00,000+.
- **Vendor Contract Checklist:**
  1. 100% source code ownership in contract.
  2. Deployment directly to client's cloud account.
  3. Direct communication with the software architect.
  4. Minimum 30-day post-launch warranty for functional bugs.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: How do you price custom software projects?
**A:** We operate on transparent, fixed-scope milestone contracts. Following an initial workflow audit, clients receive an itemized proposal with fixed delivery milestones. There are no surprise hourly invoices or recurring per-user software licensing fees.

### Q: Can our existing Tally or accounting data connect with the system?
**A:** Yes. We recommend clients maintain Tally for statutory tax filing and CA compliance while using our custom software for daily operations, stock yard management, quotations, and lorry dispatches. Clean transaction summaries can export or sync into Tally.

### Q: Do we get 100% ownership of our code and data?
**A:** Yes. Upon final milestone payment, you receive 100% ownership of the custom codebase, database schema, and intellectual property. The application is deployed directly to your own cloud infrastructure (AWS, DigitalOcean, Hetzner, or local server) with zero vendor lock-in.

### Q: Can the software work for factory workers on their mobile phones?
**A:** Yes. We specialize in mobile-first and tablet interfaces engineered specifically for factory floors and stockyard environments, featuring large touch targets, minimal typing, high-contrast typography, and instant camera scanning.

### Q: What post-deployment support is included?
**A:** Every project includes a 30-day post-launch warranty covering any functional bugs or workflow adjustments. Following the warranty period, we offer flexible on-demand support or milestone-based feature expansions.

### Q: Where is Gayatri Technology located?
**A:** Our software engineering studio is located at 1st Floor, Gayatri Technology, Street No. 7, above Gayatri Industries, Panchsheel Wadi, Samrat Industrial Area, Rajkot, Gujarat 360004, India. We serve clients across Rajkot, Jamnagar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, and internationally.
